component.name: Hungry Snake
component.summary: Grow a hungry snake, gobble apples, and climb the global leaderboard

description.p: Hungry Snake is a bright, cartoon arcade game. You guide a glossy snake around a wooden board, gobbling apples to grow ever longer — the catch is that your own tail keeps getting in the way. Clip a wall or bite yourself and the run is over, so every apple is a small gamble on how much board you can still weave through.

The snake glides smoothly from cell to cell instead of snapping, turns are buffered so quick taps never get dropped, and each run only starts once you steer — you are never thrown straight into a crash. Speed climbs slowly and announces every step-up, so even a very long snake stays controllable. Golden stars drop in for bonus points, and a mint leaf will trim your tail when you have painted yourself into a corner.

Every run pays out Coins, and the Store turns them into a deep wardrobe: snake skins, board themes, apple styles, bonus-food looks and fully animated background scenes, many colour-matched so you can assemble one coordinated look. Keep a Daily Challenge streak alive, unlock Achievements that pay out more Coins, and post your best to the opt-in global leaderboard to see how you rank worldwide.

ul.li: Smooth, glide-between-cells movement with a cute, expressive snake that blinks, flicks its tongue and watches the apple
Timed bonus foods — a golden star for extra points, a mint leaf that trims your tail when things get tight
Earn Coins just by playing, then spend them in the Store on snake skins, board themes, apple styles, bonus-food looks and animated scenes
Coordinated, scene-matched cosmetics so you can put together a cohesive view
Six hand-crafted background scenes — jungle, sunset, twilight, ember, snowfall and aurora — each with its own drifting atmosphere
A fresh Daily Challenge every day with a streak to keep alive
Achievements that pay out Coins as you hit lifetime and single-run milestones
An opt-in global leaderboard — pick a nickname, post your best run and see your worldwide rank
Six looping soundtracks plus crunchy eat and crash effects, an optional key-press blip, and a performance mode for older machines — all toggleable
Free to play with no ads: every standard cosmetic can be unlocked just by playing, with an optional Supporter Pack for a few exclusive extras
Fully offline gameplay — the leaderboard is the only online part

description.p: A big look-and-feel update.
New Supporter Pack unlocks a set of exclusive cosmetics, including the animated Aurora scene, the Golden snake and the Obsidian board.

Adds coordinated, scene-matched snakes, boards and apples so you can build a single cohesive look, plus hand-curated per-scene scenery — a realistic moon, drifting embers and mountain ranges instead of the same forest leaves everywhere.
The Game Over card is clearer (Play Again and Home), the speed ramp now climbs gently and announces each step, and there is an optional key-press sound.
Compete with everyone.
Adds an opt-in global leaderboard: pick a nickname, post your best run and see your rank straight after a high score.
The Pause and Settings menus are now separate, and the difficulty ramp is smoother and easier to read.
Restyle the whole board.
New background Scenes — Sunset, Twilight, Ember and Snowfall — each with its own animated atmosphere drifting behind the play field.
The Store has been reorganised by price and given a readability and contrast pass throughout.
Reasons to come back every day.
Adds a fresh Daily Challenge with a streak to keep alive, and Achievements that pay out Coins as you hit lifetime and single-run milestones.
Six looping soundtracks join the crunchy eat and crash effects — all toggleable.
More ways to dress up your run.
Adds apple styles and bonus-food skins to the Store, and polishes text legibility across the game.
Earn and spend.
You now collect Coins just by playing and can spend them in a new cosmetics Store on snake skins and board themes. Sound effects can be toggled on or off.
First public release of Hungry Snake.
Guide a glossy cartoon snake around a wooden board, gobble apples and grow, with a best-score trophy and crunchy eat and crash effects. Fully offline.
